name: doc
doc: HLC drift-bound KATs (TP-043). HLC_MAX_DRIFT_MS = 60_000 and the comparison is STRICT (l_msg - pt > 60_000 rejects): a peer exactly 60_000 ms ahead of the local physical clock MUST be accepted; 60_001 ms ahead MUST raise the HLC drift error (HLCDriftError / TESSERA_ID_E_HLC_DRIFT / ErrHLCDrift) and produce no output — never a clamp. Records with `expects_error` = "HLC_DRIFT" assert the rejection; runners treat success there as FAIL.
